summary: SNK's 1990 Neo Geo motorcycle racing/RPG hybrid, combining grand-prix racing, a story quest, and Neo Geo multi-link versus support.

entries.title: Riding Hero

emulation.notes: Use accurate Neo Geo MVS emulation or original hardware for the primary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Neo Geo MVS presentation with modern scaling

primary.version: Original Neo Geo MVS arcade release
primary.why: Riding Hero debuted on Neo Geo MVS arcade hardware in 1990 and was one of the first Neo Geo titles with Multi Play link support. The MVS release is the original fidelity baseline; Neo Geo AES and Neo Geo CD are home access routes with no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Neo Geo MVS version in MAME, FinalBurn Neo, MiSTer, or original MVS hardware; use AES/CD only as alternate home formats.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Neo Geo MVS arcade release with Multi Play link support.
all_releases.reason: primary: original arcade route and full-feature baseline.
skip: home access route to the same core game and no sourced exclusive content advantage over MVS.
skip: CD access route with no sourced exclusive content advantage over MVS.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content requires a secondary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; AES and CD are home-format routes for the same Neo Geo game.
